verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own desktop documentation has a dedicated 'Remote access' section covering both halves of the story: sharing your desktop remotely and accessing a remote desktop. The evidence is only documentation index titles, not the page contents, so the depth of the feature cannot be verified. Missing for 10: details of the protocols and client/server tooling, setup specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration that remote desktop works well.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my desktop remotely or access a remote desktop session from my machine
